CONTENT
COMMENTS
MINE
NOTES
Read the text and answer the question by selecting all the correct responses. More than one response is correct.
ITEM TEXT
Dennett
recognizes
that
all
human
minds
are
shaped
not
only
by
natural
selection
but
by
enormous
cultural
influenced
which
effectively
redesign
our
minds
.
He
invites
us
to
think
of
the
conscious
mind
as
consisting
of
those
mental
contents
that
win
in
competition
against
other
mental
contents
in
the
battle
for
control
of
behavior
.
What
we
are
is
the
organization
of
all
the
competitive
activity
between
a
host
of
competences
that
our
bodies
have
developed
.
Consciousness
is
defined
by
what
a
mind
can
do
whether
it
can
concentrate
,
be
distracted
,
recall
earlier
events
,
keep
track
of
a
number
of
things
at
once
etc
.
Dennett
urges
us
to
resist
the
temptation
to
imagine
animals
as
accompanying
their
clever
activities
with
streams
of
reflective
consciousness
as
we
would
.
We
may
not
know
that
they
do
not
,
but
we
certainly
cannot
assume
that
they
do
.
He
notes
that
the
more
we
learn
about
clever
activities
in
animals
and
how
they
are
accomplished
,
the
less
the
processes
in
their
brains
seem
to
resemble
the
thoughts
we
imagined
were
doing
the
work
.
ITEM QUESTION
According to Dennett, the mind displays which of the following characteristics?
ITEM CHOICES
Our
minds
are
shaped
by
natural
selection
.
Answer
Our
conscious
mind
tries
to
control
our
behaviors
.
Answer
Our
minds
are
not
shaped
by
cultural
influences
.
Animals
make
decisions
based
on
their
conscious
minds
.
A
mind
cannot
concentrate
or
cannot
be
distracted
.
